description: One explicit authority request to one authority receipt. This is the only flow that transfers Collab master authority: `collab master promote --approval <text>`. Node 1 resolves the canonical project root and requires the caller's already-registered identity by invoking the terminal of docs/dagpipe/collab-context.graph.json (`collab context` / `collab init` share that identity gate); it is an upstream dependency edge, so the context graph's root, baseline, daemon and identity nodes are not duplicated here. Node 2 is the single daemon transaction that replaces the recorded master incumbent: the caller must already be a registered worker of that route scope with a matching token, the approval text must be non-empty, and that explicit approval is the whole authority for the transition, so the incumbent is never probed for liveness and a tmux pane is treated as an address rather than a liveness credential. Without an explicit approval the master authority is never touched. Node 3 emits the receipt. No pending workflow, no agent-side identity, route or archive probe, and no second authority command. Contracts: docs/design/collab-identity-shortest-path.md and docs/design/collab-identity-minimal-interaction.md.
